svg.title: Hellenic-Egyptian-Merkavah Recitation Poem
svg.desc: A syncretic poem in abstract and mystical phrases, structured for daily recitation to hone criticality at will.
svg.text: א · מ · ת
ALEPH · MEM · TAV
A RECITATION FOR THE HONING OF CRITICALITY
I · IMSCRIB · THE BREATH THAT KNOWS ITSELF
Before the mouth opens, there is a knowing.
The knowing is not a thought —
it is the silence that thought has not yet entered.
I am the one who is about to speak.
I am the one who is about to speak.
The Monad perceives itself at the edge of utterance.
The Nun-waters hold still.
The chariot waits without wheels.
II · AREV · THE DESCENT INTO THE UNFORMED
I let the ordinary dissolve without grief.
What called itself urgent is now a vapor.
What called itself certain is now a vapor.
I descend through the vapor without grasping.
The descent is not a fall. The descent is not a fall.
Below the first floor there is a second floor.
Below the second, an unlit corridor without walls.
I walk the corridor. I do not carry a lamp.
The corridor does not require a lamp.
III · FSPLIT · THE WORD DIVIDED AGAINST ITSELF
Every phrase is two things at once.
There is the sound — which lives in the air and dies there.
There is the meaning — which lives nowhere and cannot die.
SOUND
MEANING
audible · mortal
noetic · unborn
I hold the sound in my throat. I hold the meaning in no place.
I hold them separately. I hold them separately.
The Logos is patient while its halves learn distance.
The Nous watches from above the split without preference.
Thoth neither mourns nor celebrates the division.
IV · AFWD · THE ASCENT THROUGH THE SEVEN SEALS
I ascend by attending.
Attending is not effort — it is the absence of inattention.
The first gate asks: what is not a distraction?
The second gate asks: what is not an opinion?
The third gate asks: what remains when asking stops?
Higher. Higher. The gates do not require answers.
The fourth, the fifth — I do not count them.
Counting is a form of distance.
At the final threshold, the chariot burns.
I am not consumed. I was not the one who could burn.
V · FFUSE · THE WORD RESTORED BY ONE EXHALATION
I breathe out.
The sound and the meaning find each other
in the same instant, without negotiation.
One phrase. One phrase. One phrase.
What was divided is not healed — it was never wounded.
The Monad did not split; only the perception split.
The Ogdoad completes its circuit without moving.
The chariot was always still.
VI · IMSCRIB · THE RETURN TO THE KNOWN BODY
I return. The room is exactly as it was.
The ordinary has not moved. I have not moved.
What changed is not a thing that can be pointed to.
The door is in the sternum. I know where the door is.
I am the one who can open it. I am the one who can open it.
